name: Taksa e karbonit on gazoil
law: Ligj nr. 9975, datë 28.7.2008, Për taksat kombëtare, neni 4 pika 6 shkronja b: the taksa e karbonit (carbon tax) on gazoil (diesel), 3 lekë per litre, the same in the consolidated versions 7 (ligj nr. 38/2023) and 8 (ligj nr. 96/2023) that QBZ publishes. It is a fixed amount per litre, not priced on CO2; customs collects it on imported gazoil and the tax administration on gazoil produced in Albania (neni 5), and it is passed on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).
